title: TAT-4035 account equity panel, fee tier and top nav
description: Web Terminal on Hyperliquid testnet (slot mmt-3, account dev1, market ETH, injected signer): connect the reserved account, prove the header still connects/switches/disconnects and links to Settings, then prove the order form shows the live account panel (equity, unrealized PnL, maintenance margin, margin usage, cross margin ratio) and the fee tier with the post-discount fee rate. Then open a small testnet long on the reserved market and prove, without a page reload, that uPnL, maintenance margin and margin usage go non-zero and return to zero after the close. Teardown converges the reserved market back to flat.

proofTargets.claim: Equity, uPnL, maintenance margin, and margin usage/ratio are all visible and update live off the WS-driven data already flowing through live-positions-query.ts/live-user-info-query.ts.
Fee tier and post-discount fee display correctly in the order form.
Top nav supports connect/switch/disconnect and links to settings.

setup-connect.intent: Start a fresh slot browser on the reserved market and connect the reserved account through the header

gate-order-form.intent: Make sure the connected trader sees the order form before checking the header

ac3-settings-link.intent: Confirm the top nav links to Settings

ac3-open-account-menu.intent: Open the account menu from the top nav as the trader

ac3-menu-active-account.intent: Confirm the menu lists the connected account marked active (the account switcher)

ac3-menu-add-account.intent: Confirm the menu offers adding (switching to) another account

ac3-screenshot.label: evidence-ac3-top-nav-account-menu
ac3-screenshot.intent: Keep a picture of the top nav account menu with switch and disconnect options

ac3-menu-disconnect.intent: Disconnect the wallet from the top nav menu

ac3-disconnected.intent: Confirm the top nav is back to the Connect wallet button

ac3-connect.intent: Connect the wallet again from the top nav

ac3-approve-connect.intent: Let the wallet approve the reconnection

ac3-reconnected.intent: Confirm the top nav shows the connected account again

ac1-panel-visible.intent: Confirm the order form shows the account summary panel for the connected trader

ac1-equity.intent: Confirm equity shows a live USD value

ac1-upnl.intent: Confirm unrealized PnL shows a live USD value

ac1-maintenance.intent: Confirm maintenance margin shows a USD value

ac1-margin-usage.intent: Confirm margin usage shows a percentage

ac1-margin-ratio.intent: Confirm cross margin ratio shows a percentage

ac1-wait-claimed.intent: Hold on the account summary panel before capturing it

ac1-screenshot.label: evidence-ac1-account-summary
ac1-screenshot.intent: Keep a picture of the account summary panel with equity, uPnL, maintenance margin, margin usage and ratio

ac2-fee-tier.intent: Confirm the order form summary shows the trader's fee tier

ac2-fee-rate.intent: Confirm the order form summary shows the post-discount fee rate

ac2-wait-claimed.intent: Hold on the fee tier line before capturing it

ac2-screenshot.label: evidence-ac2-fee-tier
ac2-screenshot.intent: Keep a picture of the order summary with the fee tier and post-discount fee

teardown-console.intent: Prove the session raised no unexplained console error

setup-flat.intent: Start from a flat reserved testnet market so the panel's zero and non-zero states are this run's own

ac1-flat-maintenance.intent: Confirm the flat account shows zero maintenance margin before the order

ac1-flat-upnl.intent: Confirm the flat account shows zero unrealized PnL before the order

ac1-open-position.intent: Open a small long at market from the order form (the first write approves the trading agent); the page is not reloaded after the submit

ac1-live-maintenance.intent: Confirm maintenance margin turns non-zero from the live positions stream once the position opens

ac1-live-upnl.intent: Confirm unrealized PnL turns non-zero from the live account stream

ac1-live-upnl-tone.intent: Confirm the non-zero uPnL is shown in its gain or loss color

ac1-live-margin-usage.intent: Confirm margin usage turns non-zero once the position holds margin

ac1-live-wait-claimed.intent: Hold on the account summary panel with the open position before capturing it

ac1-live-screenshot.label: evidence-ac1-account-summary-open-position
ac1-live-screenshot.intent: Keep a picture of the account summary with non-zero uPnL, maintenance margin and margin usage (equity differs from the flat capture)

ac1-close-position.intent: Close the whole position from its row without reloading the page

ac1-closed-maintenance.intent: Confirm maintenance margin returns to zero live after the close

ac1-closed-upnl.intent: Confirm unrealized PnL returns to zero live after the close

require_flat_start.intent: Clean up only when this run took ownership of the reserved market by converging it flat

teardown_clean.intent: Restore the reserved testnet market to flat after success or failure

account.description: Wallet fixture account reserved for slot mmt-3.

market.description: Testnet market reserved for slot mmt-3.

notional.description: Order amount in USD for the testnet position; at least the venue minimum.
